summary: @servicetitan/titan-chat-ui 7.1.8 executes an obfuscated Bun-runtime payload at preinstall
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip`, extracts it, chmods the bun binary executable, and invokes `execFileSync(bun_path, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')])`. The bundled sibling file math_init.js is a ~727 KB Bun-CJS blob (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with rotated string-array obfuscation, single-character mangled identifiers, and a rotator function that shifts array entries at runtime. The package is published as a React chat UI and has no functional need for a second language runtime, nor for a large obfuscated blob named math_init.js, at install time. The combination — alternate-runtime download at preinstall used solely to execute an obfuscated in-tree payload whose contents mismatch the advertised purpose — is an install-time code-execution dropper on any machine that runs `npm install` against this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
